title: Brazil Star Neymar Announces International Retirement: 'It Is Now Over'
facts: Neymar announced his retirement from international football after Brazil's 2-1 loss to Norway in the World Cup round of 16. [cite: 253]
Neymar concludes his international career as the top goalscorer in the history of the Brazilian men's national team. [cite: 253]
Neymar scored 80 goals in 129 appearances for the Brazilian men's national team. [cite: 253]
Neymar made his senior international debut for the Brazilian national team in 2010. [cite: 253]
Neymar participated in four separate World Cup tournaments during his career. [cite: 253]
Neymar competed in two Olympic tournaments representing Brazil. [cite: 253]
Neymar won a silver medal with the Brazilian team at the 2012 Olympic tournament. [cite: 253]
Neymar led the Brazilian national team to a gold medal at the 2016 Olympics. [cite: 253]
Neymar made exactly two substitute appearances for Brazil during the 2026 World Cup. [cite: 253]
Neymar scored his only goal of the 2026 World Cup from a penalty kick against Norway in stoppage time. [cite: 253]
Neymar made a second-half cameo appearance against Scotland during the 2026 World Cup group stage. [cite: 253]
Thierry Henry praised Neymar's overall career on the FOX Sports program 'World Cup Today'. [cite: 253]
Zlatan Ibrahimović publicly commended Neymar's football career and skill set following the retirement announcement. [cite: 253]
Zlatan Ibrahimović noted that people wanted Neymar to win the Ballon d'Or but he did not achieve the award. [cite: 253]
Norway advanced to the 2026 World Cup quarterfinals to play the winner of the match between Mexico and England. [cite: 253]
